plan.subject: Understand the core principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.
plan.objective: Understand the core principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.

blocks.title: Linear Regression Definition
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation of predictive modeling for continuous outputs.

blocks.title: Cost Function (Mean Squared Error)
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function measures prediction error and is essential for model evaluation.
examples: MSE is a differentiable and convex function

blocks.title: Gradient Descent
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is the primary optimization technique used to minimize the cost function.
examples: Using an iterative optimization algorithm, gradient descent 2.

blocks.title: Model Parameters (Intercept and Regression Coefficient)
blocks.teachingObjective: These parameters define the relationship between input and output variables in linear regression.
examples: 퐰 ퟎ : Intercept (where the line crosses y - axis) 2.
